cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用 `Blueprint C++ Header Preview`（模块 `BlueprintHeaderView`）并重启；该工具只服务把蓝图类迁到原生 C++，不要写进 Shipping 依赖。
打开要迁移的 `Blueprint Class` 或用户结构体；在内容浏览器右键该资产，选 `Preview Equivalent C++ Header`。
也可从 `Window > Developer Tools > C++ Header Preview` 打开面板，再点选同一蓝图，预览生成的 `.h`。
对照面板里的 `UCLASS` / `UPROPERTY` / `UFUNCTION` 声明，把变量、函数、组件和事件分发器抄进自己的 C++ 头文件。
在 `Project Settings` 或编辑器设置里查看 `UBlueprintHeaderViewSettings`（排序、语法高亮颜色），按团队命名习惯调整预览。
在游戏模块里手写对应 `.cpp` 实现；预览不会把图表逻辑编译成可发布 C++。
用 Core Redirects 把旧蓝图类引用指到新 native 类，编译并在编辑器里核对引用不再指向原蓝图。
en_steps: Enable `Blueprint C++ Header Preview` in `Edit > Plugins` (module `BlueprintHeaderView`) and restart. It is an editor conversion aid, not a Shipping dependency.
Select the `Blueprint Class` or user struct to migrate; in the Content Browser right-click it and choose `Preview Equivalent C++ Header`.
Alternatively open `Window > Developer Tools > C++ Header Preview` and pick the same Blueprint to show the generated `.h`.
Copy the previewed `UCLASS` / `UPROPERTY` / `UFUNCTION` declarations (variables, functions, components, event dispatchers) into your own C++ header.
Tune preview sorting and syntax colors via `UBlueprintHeaderViewSettings` in editor/project settings.
Implement the matching `.cpp` by hand; the preview does not convert graph bodies into shipping C++.
Remap old Blueprint class references with Core Redirects, rebuild, and confirm assets now parent to the native class.
note_cn: 只生成声明预览，不生成图表实现；编辑器插件，勿加入游戏运行时 `Build.cs`。
note_en: Header preview only — no graph-to-C++ body. Editor plugin; do not add `BlueprintHeaderView` to game runtime `Build.cs`.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用 `Blueprint File Utilities`（模块 `BlueprintFileUtils`）并重启。
在编辑器工具蓝图或开发用关卡蓝图里搜索 `FileUtils` 分类，目标类是 `UBlueprintFileUtilsBPLibrary`。
用 `File Exists` / `Directory Exists` 校验绝对路径，再用 `Make Directory`（可勾选 Create Tree）创建目录树。
用 `Copy File` 或 `Move File`（参数：Dest Filename、Src Filename、Replace、Even If Read Only）搬运文件；Dest 在上、Src 在下。
用 `Find Files`（Directory + 可选 File Extension）列出单层目录，或 `Find Recursive`（Wildcard、bFindFiles、bFindDirectories）扫子目录。
删除时调用库里的 Delete File / Delete Directory；先 `File Exists` 再删，避免误伤只读或正在写入的文件。
C++ 侧在模块 `Build.cs` 加入 `BlueprintFileUtils`，`#include "BlueprintFileUtilsBPLibrary.h"`，调用同名静态函数；打包游戏请限制在开发/工具路径，不要对玩家机任意写盘。
en_steps: Enable `Blueprint File Utilities` in `Edit > Plugins` (module `BlueprintFileUtils`) and restart.
In an editor utility or development Level Blueprint, search the `FileUtils` category; the target is `UBlueprintFileUtilsBPLibrary`.
Guard with `File Exists` / `Directory Exists` on absolute paths, then `Make Directory` (Create Tree) if needed.
Use `Copy File` or `Move File` (Dest Filename, Src Filename, Replace, Even If Read Only). Dest is the top pin, Src the bottom.
List a folder with `Find Files` (Directory + optional File Extension) or walk trees with `Find Recursive` (Wildcard, bFindFiles, bFindDirectories).
Delete via the library’s Delete File / Delete Directory after an existence check so you do not clobber read-only or in-use files.
In C++, add `BlueprintFileUtils` to `Build.cs`, `#include "BlueprintFileUtilsBPLibrary.h"`, and call the same statics. Restrict packaged use to tool paths; do not write arbitrary player disks.
note_cn: 路径必须是绝对路径；`Copy File` 对正在被写入的文件可能失败。这是低级文件系统 API，不是内容浏览器资产复制。
note_en: Paths must be absolute; `Copy File` can fail on files that are still being written. This is OS file I/O, not Content Browser asset duplication.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用实验性 `Blueprint Graph Formatter`（模块 `BlueprintGraphFormatter`、`BlueprintGraphFormatterToolset`）并重启。
打开任意蓝图的 Event Graph 或函数图，确认图中已有执行链、输入参数节点和注释框。
在图表内按 `G`：插件会把执行排成从左到右、拉直连线、摆放输入、收缩注释框并堆叠事件块。
若快捷键冲突，到 `Edit > Editor Preferences > Keyboard Shortcuts` 搜索 Graph Formatter / Format Blueprint Graph，改绑后再格式化。
先框选一小段乱线图验证规则，再对整张图按 `G`；逻辑不变，只改节点坐标与线型。
编辑器 AI 助手若已接 Toolset，可通过 `BlueprintGraphFormatterToolset` 对同一套排版规则做自动格式化；不要把这两个模块加进游戏 `Build.cs`。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Blueprint Graph Formatter` in `Edit > Plugins` (modules `BlueprintGraphFormatter`, `BlueprintGraphFormatterToolset`) and restart.
Open a Blueprint Event Graph or function graph that already has execution wires, input nodes, and comment boxes.
Press `G` in the graph: execution is laid out left-to-right, wires straightened, inputs placed, comment boxes fitted, and event blocks stacked.
If `G` conflicts, rebind under `Edit > Editor Preferences > Keyboard Shortcuts` (Graph Formatter / Format Blueprint Graph) and format again.
Prove the rules on a small selection before formatting the whole graph; node logic is untouched, only layout.
Editor AI assistants can reuse the same rules through `BlueprintGraphFormatterToolset`. Do not add either module to a game `Build.cs`.
note_cn: Experimental：只整理布局，不改编译结果。快捷键默认 `G`，可在 Keyboard Shortcuts 重绑。
note_en: Experimental: layout only, no compile-behavior change. Default hotkey is `G`; rebind in Keyboard Shortcuts.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用 `Blueprint Material and Texture Nodes`（模块 `BlueprintMaterialTextureNodes`）并重启；节点全部是 Editor Only。
在编辑器工具蓝图（Blutility）里搜 `Create MIC Editor Only`，对已有 `UMaterialInterface` 生成 `UMaterialInstanceConstant` 资产。

接着用 `Set MIC Scalar Param Editor Only` / `Set MIC Vector Param Editor Only` / `Set MIC Texture Param Editor Only` 写参数；需要时再调 `Set MIC Blend Mode Editor Only`、`Set MIC Shading Model Editor Only`、`Set MIC Two Sided Editor Only`。
采样贴图用 `Texture2D Sample UV Editor Only`；采样 `TextureRenderTarget2D` 用 `Render Target Sample UV Editor Only`（单点）或 `Render Target Sample Rectangle Editor Only`（矩形，仅四通道格式）。
这些节点会同步读 GPU，只能在编辑器脚本/工具里跑，不要放进游戏 BeginPlay。
C++ 对应 `UBlueprintMaterialTextureNodesBPLibrary`（`BlueprintMaterialTextureNodesBPLibrary.h`）；游戏运行时模块不要依赖它。
en_steps: Enable `Blueprint Material and Texture Nodes` in `Edit > Plugins` (module `BlueprintMaterialTextureNodes`) and restart. Every node is Editor Only.
In an Editor Utility Blueprint, call `Create MIC Editor Only` on a `UMaterialInterface` to spawn a `UMaterialInstanceConstant` asset.

Write parameters with `Set MIC Scalar Param Editor Only` / `Set MIC Vector Param Editor Only` / `Set MIC Texture Param Editor Only`; optionally `Set MIC Blend Mode Editor Only`, `Set MIC Shading Model Editor Only`, `Set MIC Two Sided Editor Only`.

Sample a `Texture2D` with `Texture2D Sample UV Editor Only`. Sample a `TextureRenderTarget2D` with `Render Target Sample UV Editor Only` (one UV) or `Render Target Sample Rectangle Editor Only` (rect; four-channel formats only).
These calls stall on a GPU readback — editor scripts only, never gameplay `BeginPlay`.
C++ entry is `UBlueprintMaterialTextureNodesBPLibrary` (`BlueprintMaterialTextureNodesBPLibrary.h`). Do not depend on it from a cooked game module.
note_cn: 全部带 Editor Only：会 GPU readback。运行时请用 `UKismetRenderingLibrary` 的异步/延迟读回，而不是这些节点。
note_en: All nodes are Editor Only and GPU-sync. For runtime, use `UKismetRenderingLibrary` async/deferred readback instead.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用实验性 `Blueprint Snap Nodes Prototype`（模块 `BlueprintSnapNodes`）并重启。
打开蓝图图表，在节点搜索里找 `Snap` / Snap Container，放入一张空容器节点。
按容器提示把已有节点拖进框内（目前主要靠拖放，不能在容器内直接搜节点添加）。
带参数的节点会收成类似函数调用的紧凑行；参数名被省略，悬停引脚查看含义，把连线拖到参数槽绑定。
容器内部本质是折叠图 + Sequence；要改内部逻辑需双击进入，删除节点往往要进容器内部手动拆。
只在实验图表上试用紧凑布局，确认编译与调试断点仍可用后再考虑团队规范；不要把 `BlueprintSnapNodes` 加入游戏 `Build.cs`。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Blueprint Snap Nodes Prototype` in `Edit > Plugins` (module `BlueprintSnapNodes`) and restart.
In a Blueprint graph, search for `Snap` / Snap Container and place an empty container.
Drag existing nodes into the box (drag-and-drop is the supported add path; you cannot search-add inside the container).
Parameterized nodes collapse into compact call-like rows; argument names are hidden — hover pins, and drag wires onto argument slots to bind.
Internally the container is a collapsed graph plus Sequence; edit or delete nodes by opening the container, not from the outer graph alone.
Prototype on a throwaway graph and confirm compile/debug still work before adopting it. Do not add `BlueprintSnapNodes` to a game `Build.cs`.
note_cn: Experimental 原型：添加依赖拖放，删除/self 引脚仍有已知限制，勿用于正式资产流水线。
note_en: Experimental prototype: add-by-drag only; delete/self-pin handling is incomplete. Keep it off production assets.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用 `Blueprint Stats`（模块 `BlueprintStats`）并重启；这是编辑器统计命令，不是运行时计数器。
打开 `Window > Output Log`，确保日志过滤器包含 `LogBlueprintStats`。
在控制台执行 `DumpBlueprintStats`。
阅读输出：先是各 `K2Node_*` / AnimGraph 节点类型的出现次数，再是 `FunctionPath,ClassName,FunctionName,NumInstances` 函数调用排行。
用这份清单找项目里滥用最多的节点（例如海量 `Add_IntInt` 或特定 `K2Node_Event`），决定哪些图该下沉到 C++。
不要把 `BlueprintStats` 写进游戏 `Build.cs`；命令只扫描当前编辑器已加载的蓝图。
en_steps: Enable `Blueprint Stats` in `Edit > Plugins` (module `BlueprintStats`) and restart. It is an editor dump command, not a runtime counter.
Open `Window > Output Log` and keep `LogBlueprintStats` visible in the filter.
Run the console command `DumpBlueprintStats`.
Read the dump: counts per `K2Node_*` / AnimGraph node class, then the `FunctionPath,ClassName,FunctionName,NumInstances` table.
Use the hot list (heavy `Add_IntInt`, `K2Node_Event`, etc.) to decide which graphs should move to C++.
Do not add `BlueprintStats` to a game `Build.cs`; the command only scans Blueprints loaded in this editor session.
note_cn: 唯一正式入口是控制台 `DumpBlueprintStats`；没有独立 Window 面板，也没有游戏内 Stat 组。
note_en: The real entry is the `DumpBlueprintStats` console command. There is no dedicated window and no in-game Stat group.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用实验性 `Blueprint Toolsets`（模块 `BlueprintToolsets`），并同时启用编辑器 AI / Toolset Registry 相关插件后重启。
确认助手能看到蓝图工具集：它提供针对蓝图资产的只读/只写工具，核心是 `Blueprint Graph DSL`。
在编辑器 AI 会话里指定一张蓝图资产，让助手用 DSL 描述 Event Graph / 函数图上的节点与连线，而不是让它猜截图。
需要改图时，走工具集的写接口应用 DSL 补丁（添加节点、接线、设引脚），再在蓝图编辑器里打开该资产核对编译。
把 `Blueprint Graph Formatter` 的 toolset 模块当作排版补充，而不是替代本插件的 DSL 读写。
此插件只服务编辑器自动化/AI，切勿加入 Shipping 游戏模块。
en_steps: Enable experimental `Blueprint Toolsets` in `Edit > Plugins` (module `BlueprintToolsets`), plus the editor AI / Toolset Registry plugins, then restart.
Confirm the assistant lists Blueprint tools: read/write helpers for Blueprint assets, including the `Blueprint Graph DSL`.
In an editor AI session, point at one Blueprint asset and have the assistant describe Event/function graphs via the DSL instead of guessing from screenshots.
To mutate a graph, apply DSL patches through the write tools (add nodes, wires, pin values), then open the asset in the Blueprint editor and compile.
Treat `BlueprintGraphFormatterToolset` as layout-only; this plugin owns structural DSL read/write.
Editor automation/AI only — never add `BlueprintToolsets` to a Shipping game module.
note_cn: Experimental Toolset：给编辑器 AI 用的 Blueprint Graph DSL，不是运行时蓝图 API。
note_en: Experimental toolset: Blueprint Graph DSL for the in-editor AI, not a runtime Blueprint API.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用 `Bridge`（模块 `Bridge`、`MegascansPlugin`）并重启。
打开 `Window > Quixel Bridge`（部分版本在模式工具栏的 Bridge 按钮）。
用 Epic Games 账号登录 Megascans，在 Bridge 里按 3D Asset / Surface / 3D Plant 浏览并选 LOD/分辨率。
下载后由 `MegascansPlugin` 导入工程，内容浏览器会出现 `Megascans` 目录下的静态网格、贴图和材质实例。
把导入的网格拖进关卡，检查自动生成的 MIC 是否接到正确贴图槽；需要时在材质实例里改材质质量或置换。
这是编辑器导入链路，不要把 `Bridge` / `MegascansPlugin` 加进游戏运行时 `Build.cs`；Shipping 只保留已导入的 uasset。
en_steps: Enable `Bridge` in `Edit > Plugins` (modules `Bridge`, `MegascansPlugin`) and restart.
Open `Window > Quixel Bridge` (some builds also expose a Bridge button on the mode toolbar).
Sign in with an Epic account, browse 3D Assets / Surfaces / 3D Plants, and pick LOD and texture resolution.
`MegascansPlugin` imports the download into the project under a `Megascans` folder (meshes, textures, material instances).
Drop meshes in the level and verify the generated MICs wire the expected texture slots; tweak quality or displacement on the instance as needed.
Editor import pipeline only — do not add `Bridge` or `MegascansPlugin` to a game `Build.cs`. Shipping should contain the imported uassets, not Bridge.
note_cn: Quixel/Megascans 导入器，与 Gameplay Ability System 无关。导入结果是普通静态网格与材质实例。
note_en: Quixel Megascans importer — unrelated to Gameplay Ability System. You ship the imported meshes/MICs, not the Bridge UI.

cn_steps: 同时启用 `Water` 与实验性 `Buoyancy`（模块 `Buoyancy`），重启编辑器。
在关卡放置 `Water Body Ocean` / `Lake` / `River`，确保水体已生成可采样的水面。
做一个带 `Static Mesh` 的 Actor，开启 Simulate Physics，碰撞简单（盒/凸包），质量不要为 0。
在组件面板添加 `UBuoyancyComponent`，在 `Buoyancy Data > Pontoons` 里加若干 `FSphericalPontoon`（Relative Location + Radius），至少四点才能让船体稳住。
需要河流推力时配置 `Buoyancy Data` 里的 Water Velocity Strength、River Pontoon Index、Shore Push 等；进水/出水可绑 `On Pontoon Entered Water` / `On Pontoon Exited Water`。
Play 或 Simulate，物体应落到水面并随波；Water 内容示例 `BP_BuoyancyExample` 可直接拖到水面上对照。
C++：`Build.cs` 依赖 `Buoyancy`（及 `Water`），`#include "BuoyancyComponent.h"`，在 `BeginPlay` 里 `AddCustomPontoon`；不要在构造函数里注册该组件。
en_steps: Enable both `Water` and experimental `Buoyancy` (module `Buoyancy`), then restart.
Place a `Water Body Ocean` / `Lake` / `River` so there is a sampleable water surface.
Create an Actor with a `Static Mesh`, Simulate Physics on, simple collision, non-zero mass.
Add `UBuoyancyComponent`. Under `Buoyancy Data > Pontoons` add `FSphericalPontoon` entries (Relative Location + Radius); four corners stabilize a hull.
For rivers, tune Water Velocity Strength, River Pontoon Index, and shore push on `Buoyancy Data`. Bind `On Pontoon Entered Water` / `On Pontoon Exited Water` for FX.
Play or Simulate: the body should settle on the surface. Compare with Water content `BP_BuoyancyExample`.
C++: depend on `Buoyancy` (and `Water`) in `Build.cs`, `#include "BuoyancyComponent.h"`, call `AddCustomPontoon` in `BeginPlay` — not in the constructor.
note_cn: 必须配合 Water 水体；浮筒没有视口可视化，用 Scene 组件坐标抄到 Relative Location。Experimental。
note_en: Requires Water bodies. Pontoons have no viewport gizmo — copy Scene component locations into Relative Location. Experimental.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 启用 `Cable Component`（模块 `CableComponent`）并重启。
从放置 Actor 面板拖 `Cable Actor`（`ACableActor`），或给已有 Actor 添加 `UCableComponent`。
起点默认绑在组件变换上（`Attach Start`）。在 Details 的 Cable 里指定 `Attach End To` 目标 Actor/组件，可选 `Attach End To Socket Name`，并用 `End Location` 微调。
关掉 `Attach End` 可让末端自由摆动；保持两端附着则变成固定悬索。用 `Set Attach End To` / `Set Attach End To Component` 可在运行时改挂点。
调节 `Cable Length`、`Num Segments`、`Solver Iterations`、`Cable Gravity Scale`、`Enable Stiffness`；碰撞用实验性 `Enable Collision`（成本高）。
渲染：`Cable Width`、`Num Sides`、`Tile Material`，给组件指定一条沿 U 方向平铺的材质。
C++：`PublicDependencyModuleNames` 加 `CableComponent`，`#include "CableComponent.h"`；`Num Segments` 是 `BlueprintReadOnly`，分段数在编辑器或构造时设好。
en_steps: Enable `Cable Component` in `Edit > Plugins` (module `CableComponent`) and restart.
Place a `Cable Actor` (`ACableActor`) or add `UCableComponent` to an existing Actor.
Start is the component transform (`Attach Start`). In Details > Cable set `Attach End To` (Actor/component), optional `Attach End To Socket Name`, and `End Location`.
Clear `Attach End` to let the tip swing; keep both ends attached for a catenary. At runtime use `Set Attach End To` / `Set Attach End To Component`.
Tune `Cable Length`, `Num Segments`, `Solver Iterations`, `Cable Gravity Scale`, `Enable Stiffness`. `Enable Collision` is experimental and expensive.
Render with `Cable Width`, `Num Sides`, `Tile Material`, and a material that tiles along U.
C++: add `CableComponent` to `PublicDependencyModuleNames`, `#include "CableComponent.h"`. `Num Segments` is `BlueprintReadOnly` — set it in the editor or at construction.
note_cn: 运行时可进包装。`Get Cable Particle Locations` 可取世界空间粒子点；不要在运行时改 `Num Segments`。
note_en: Ships at runtime. `Get Cable Particle Locations` returns world-space particles. Do not change `Num Segments` at runtime.

cn_steps: 同时启用 `Cadence` 与 `Cadence Input System`（模块 `CadenceInput`），并保持 `Enhanced Input` 开启，然后重启。
按 Enhanced Input 常规流程创建 `UInputAction` 和 `UInputMappingContext`，通过 `UEnhancedInputLocalPlayerSubsystem` 加到本地玩家。
把会改变模拟状态的玩法（移动、开火、跳跃）绑在 Input Action 的 `Triggered` / `Started` / `Completed` 委托上，而不是每帧轮询按键。
`CadenceInput` 会按固定子 tick 记录这些已执行的 action 委托；网络回滚时按同一帧顺序重放，从而参加 Cadence 的 resimulation。
不要在普通 `Tick` 里直接读原始按键来改 Chaos/位置，否则回放对不上记录的输入。
需要扩展时在模块 `Build.cs` 加入 `CadenceInput`（通常还要 `Cadence`、`EnhancedInput`），以引擎该模块 Public 头文件为准。
用 Cadence 校正/resim 报告或 `Cadence Tests` 夹具验证：同一输入序列在客户端预测与服务器重放后状态一致。
en_steps: Enable `Cadence` and `Cadence Input System` (module `CadenceInput`) together with `Enhanced Input`, then restart.
Author `UInputAction` and `UInputMappingContext` as usual and add the context via `UEnhancedInputLocalPlayerSubsystem`.
Drive sim-changing gameplay (move, fire, jump) from Input Action `Triggered` / `Started` / `Completed` delegates, not from raw key polling.
`CadenceInput` records those executed action delegates per Cadence sub-tick and replays them in order on rollback so input joins resimulation.
Do not mutate Chaos/transform from a generic `Tick` that reads hardware keys — that path is invisible to recorded replay.
To extend in C++, add `CadenceInput` (typically with `Cadence` and `EnhancedInput`) in `Build.cs` and follow that module’s Public headers.
Verify with Cadence correction/resim reports or the `Cadence Tests` fixture that a recorded input sequence matches after client predict and server replay.
note_cn: 它扩展 Enhanced Input 的委托记录/重放，并不替换 Mapping Context。玩法必须走 action 委托才能进 Cadence 回滚。
note_en: Records and replays Enhanced Input action delegates; it does not replace Mapping Contexts. Gameplay must sit on those delegates to join Cadence rollback.

cn_steps: 在源码版引擎启用 `Cadence`、`Cadence Input System` 与 `Cadence Modular Tests`（模块 `CadenceModularTests`）。
打开 `Window > Developer Tools > Session Frontend`，切到 `Automation` 页。
过滤器输入 `Cadence` / Modular，勾选 Cadence 的 Modular Test Framework 用例（独立进程里拉起 server + clients）。
运行后不要只看 Pass/Fail：打开 Cadence 的 correction 与 resim report，确认客户端预测偏差被重模拟纠正。
也可从命令行跑对应 Modular Test / Gauntlet 目标，便于 CI；失败时保留多进程日志而不是只看编辑器 Output Log。
这是引擎测试插件，不要写进游戏 `Build.cs` 或 Shipping。
en_steps: On a source engine, enable `Cadence`, `Cadence Input System`, and `Cadence Modular Tests` (module `CadenceModularTests`).
Open `Window > Developer Tools > Session Frontend` → `Automation`.
Filter `Cadence` / Modular and run the Modular Test Framework cases (server + clients in separate processes).
Inspect Cadence correction and resim reports, not only Pass/Fail, to confirm prediction error is fixed by resimulation.
From CI, launch the matching Modular Test / Gauntlet target and keep per-process logs.
Engine test plugin only — do not add `CadenceModularTests` to a game `Build.cs` or Shipping build.
note_cn: 与同目录下的 `Cadence Tests` 不同：这里是多进程 Modular Test Framework，靠 correction/resim 报告验收。
note_en: Unlike in-process `Cadence Tests`, this is multi-process Modular Test Framework gated on correction/resim reports.

cn_steps: 启用 `Cadence`、`Cadence SceneGraph`、Scene Graph / Verse 支持以及 `Cadence SceneGraph Tests`（模块 `CadenceSceneGraphTests`）。
在 `Session Frontend > Automation` 中筛选 `CadenceSceneGraph` 规范（specs）。
这些用例走 Cadence 的 client/server fixture：带 `<predicts>` 的 `TickEvents` 处理程序在客户端跑，再被 resimulation 重放。
Verse 探针会断言 Scene Graph 实体在预测帧与重放帧上的变换/输入一致；失败时对照 fixture 的帧时间与数据包设定。
改 Scene Graph 或 Verse 输入后重新编译 Verse，再跑同一组 specs，不要靠手工 PIE 代替。
测试模块不进游戏包；不要把 `CadenceSceneGraphTests` 加入运行时 `Build.cs`。
en_steps: Enable `Cadence`, `Cadence SceneGraph`, Scene Graph / Verse support, and `Cadence SceneGraph Tests` (module `CadenceSceneGraphTests`).
In `Session Frontend > Automation`, filter the `CadenceSceneGraph` specs.
Cases use the Cadence client/server fixture: `<predicts>` `TickEvents` handlers run on clients and are replayed by resimulation.
Verse probes assert Scene Graph transforms/input match between predicted and replayed frames; on failure compare fixture frame time and packet settings.
After Scene Graph or Verse input changes, compile Verse and rerun the same specs — do not substitute a manual PIE session.
Test-only; do not add `CadenceSceneGraphTests` to a runtime `Build.cs`.
note_cn: 专门覆盖 Cadence 下 Scene Graph 的 `<predicts>` TickEvents 与 Verse 探针，不是通用物理自动化。
note_en: Covers Scene Graph `<predicts>` TickEvents and Verse probes under Cadence, not generic physics automation.

cn_steps: 启用 `Cadence`、`Cadence Input System` 与 `Cadence SceneGraph`（模块 `CadenceSceneGraph`），并打开项目的 Scene Graph / Verse。
用 Scene Graph 实体作为玩家拥有物（possess），而不是只依赖传统 Pawn 复制。
在实体上使用 `possessed_input_component`（文档也称 own_input_component）：客户端输入经 Cadence 复制后，服务器侧喂给 Verse input，各端组件都能读到同一份输入。
Cadence 状态缓存会记下这些被拥有实体；每帧把复制过来的变换与客户端对该帧的预测比较，偏差则触发 resimulation 纠正。
玩法移动/朝向应写在可预测的 Scene Graph / Verse 路径上，避免在不可回放的 Actor Tick 里改同一变换。
C++ 游戏代码若要挂钩，仅对需要扩展的模块依赖 `CadenceSceneGraph`，并以该模块 Public 头文件为准。
用 `Cadence SceneGraph Tests` 的 specs 回归 possess 变换纠正与输入转发。
en_steps: Enable `Cadence`, `Cadence Input System`, and `Cadence SceneGraph` (module `CadenceSceneGraph`), with Scene Graph / Verse on in the project.
Possess Scene Graph entities as the player-owned objects rather than relying only on classic Pawn replication.
Put `possessed_input_component` (also called own_input_component in the plugin text) on those entities: Cadence-replicated input is fed to Verse input on the server and to the component everywhere.
Cadence’s state cache tracks possessed entities, compares replicated transforms to the client prediction for the same frame, and corrects with resimulation.
Keep movement/aim on the predict-able Scene Graph / Verse path; do not also write the same transform from an unreplayable Actor `Tick`.
If you extend in C++, depend on `CadenceSceneGraph` only where needed and follow that module’s Public headers.
Regress possess-transform correction and input forwarding with `Cadence SceneGraph Tests` specs.
note_cn: 职责是 possess 的 Scene Graph 实体进 Cadence 状态缓存，并转发复制输入到 Verse / `possessed_input_component`。
note_en: Tracks possessed Scene Graph entities in the Cadence state cache and forwards replicated input to Verse and `possessed_input_component`.

cn_steps: 启用 `Cadence` 与 `Cadence Tests`（模块 `CadenceTests`）；这是进程内 client/server 测试夹具，不是游戏功能。
打开 `Window > Developer Tools > Session Frontend > Automation`，筛选 `Cadence` 自动化 specs。
夹具会在 Cadence 下同时构造 server world 与 client world，按种子化的帧时间逐帧 `Tick`。
带数据包延迟或丢包的用例用来验证固定子 tick、输入复制和 resim 在劣网下仍收敛。
失败时对照夹具的 seeded frame time 与 delay/loss 参数复现，而不是只开 PIE 肉眼看。
需要自己加 spec 时依赖 `CadenceTests` 模块并沿用其 client/server fixture；不要把该模块打进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Cadence` and `Cadence Tests` (module `CadenceTests`). This is an in-process client/server fixture, not gameplay.
Open `Window > Developer Tools > Session Frontend > Automation` and filter `Cadence` specs.
The fixture builds server and client worlds under Cadence and `Tick`s them frame-by-frame with seeded frame times.
Cases that inject packet delay or loss check that fixed sub-ticks, input replication, and resim still converge.
On failure, replay with the fixture’s seeded frame time and delay/loss knobs rather than a manual PIE session.
New specs should depend on `CadenceTests` and reuse its fixture. Do not ship the module.
note_cn: 进程内、可种子化帧时间和丢包的 Cadence 夹具；多进程场景请用 `Cadence Modular Tests`。
note_en: In-process Cadence fixture with seeded frame times and packet delay/loss. Use `Cadence Modular Tests` for separate processes.
